items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Paul Whiteman only in the context of Frankie Trumbauer being 'with Whiteman' and a story about attending a concert where Whiteman's name was used to gain entry. The interviewee never states they met, worked with, or had a personal relationship with Paul Whiteman himself.

ctx.x: He was with Whiteman, he and Bix, I met Bix one time.
